reason: I do not pay for advice from somebody I cannot place. If you have not fixed this for another HVAC or plumbing shop around Roscoe that I can call, I have got no reason to hand you an hour of my week. The free look is tempting, but I have been pitched free assessments before and it turns into a sales call.
objection: A guy who has never run a service truck is going to look at my quote pile and tell me to buy software, when the real problem is I am on a roof until 6 and forget to call anybody back. I need to hear from an owner in town who says he actually fixed it, not from you.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three owners I know, a plumber and an electrician within an hour of Roscoe, telling me straight that he fixed a real leak in their follow-up and did not touch their accounts or upsell them. Give me their numbers and I will call them myself.
